entries.question: Which handle policy should #6278 adopt: the identity resolver learns the human slug (option A, keeps the shipped agent tasks status behavior) or the human slug is refused everywhere (option B)?
entries.rationale: Operator intent recorded in issue #6278 (first option). The human slug is already a supported, documented handle on agent tasks status / agent status; refusing it everywhere would remove shipped behavior and leave the same split in the other direction. Folding in the shared ladder fixes implement and every other resolve_mission caller at once.
